Ripplr is a digital-first distribution platform for new-age consumer brands. It offers an end to end logistics support to brands in an asset-light approach within their existing infrastructure, essentially becoming a plug-and-play model. In addition to being an easy to deploy solution, Ripplr also offers data driven prediction analysis and operational visibility to brands, helping them achieve higher reach and visibility in the market. Currently, over 20 brands are now able to reach 30,000+ retail stores across 6 cities through Ripplr.
